# PR 002 — Force fragile dominance and test recovery

> Reconstructed on 2026-10-11. Historical evidence window: 2026-10-04 18:41–18:46 UTC.

**Branch:** `research/exp-02-fragile-dominance`  
**Base:** `main`  
**Tag:** `v0.2.0`

## Hypothesis

When glasses destroy dominant eye cue A, a few-shot router can shift toward retained lower-face cue B or chromatic cue C.

## Result

Global glasses accuracy was 0.5000. Adaptive routing reached 0.6302 ± 0.1064 at K=8, with a mean shift from approximately [0.904,0.088,0.008] to [0.451,0.539,0.010].

## Review decision

Merge as partial support. High variance and locked seeds motivate an ablation of functional access rather than feature presence.
